title: The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy- is Kazutaka Kodaka's magnum opus
description: Though my favorite routes might be the ones written by Kotaro Uchikoshi. Masafumi Takada returning for the soundtrack and Rui Komatsuzaki returning for art make me glad that Too Kyo games is still around and successful. This is an absolutely massive game, and my feelings about it are complex and hard to cover.
